description:
Move the gate preset case that only the exit-code suite tests beside the gate preset tests.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/exit_code_tests.rs` (39 subprocess tests) re-proves projected exit codes and also owns behaviour no other test owns. The exit-code projection suite owns command-to-exit-code bindings and their human/machine parity: outside it, a subprocess test asserts success or failure and the property it adds, and names a numeric exit code only for a command and code pair the projection has no row for. This entry covers these cases:

- `:1079`: `gate preset create` naming a gate that was removed from the registry ("Gate not found in registry: mygate").

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The case has an owning test in `cli_repo_workflow/gate_preset_tests.rs` with the same non-exit assertion.
- [hard] REQ-02: The moved case names a numeric exit code only where the projection has no row for its command and code.
title: Gate preset registry case moves beside its owner
